items.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna from OpenAI on Amazon Bedrock.

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on AWS GovCloud (US)
items.blurb: AWS GovCloud (US) now offers Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic’s most capable Opus model yet and, the first of the Claude 5.5 model family, a better collaborator that handles long-running coding and knowledge work, reporting back clearly on what…

items.title: Article: Modular Edge Computing at Multi-Tenant SaaS Scale on Cloudflare Workers
items.blurb: At multi-tenant SaaS scale, a monolithic edge worker creates deployment coupling and broad blast radius.

items.title: Elastic Beanstalk Adds Cluster Mode, Running Applications on Shared EKS Clusters
items.blurb: AWS has added Cluster Mode to Elastic Beanstalk, running applications on EKS clusters the service creates and operates.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni: AI-first observability for agents and applications
items.blurb: AWS announces the general availability of Amazon CloudWatch Omni, an evolution of Amazon CloudWatch.

items.title: Billing Transfer now supports automatic billing group creation for two-level transfers
items.blurb: AWS Billing Transfer users can now enable the Auto-Billing Transfer Billing Group Creation, a new AWS Billing Conductor preference that eliminates the manual billing group configuration in two-level billing transfer arrangements.

items.title: Amazon EMR introduces Long Term Support with Apache Spark 4.1
items.blurb: Amazon EMR introduces Long Term Support (LTS) releases, starting with emr-spark-8.1.0 and Apache Spark 4.1. With LTS, designated versions of the AWS runtime for Apache Spark receive 36 months of support.

items.title: Amazon Route 53 Resolver is now generally available on second-generation AWS Outposts racks
items.blurb: Amazon Route 53 Resolver is now generally available on second-generation AWS Outposts, providing local, managed recursive DNS resolution directly on your Outpost.
